title: connector.update
description: Update existing connectors. Only the connectorid property is required; only passed properties are updated, the rest remain unchanged.

connectorid.description: ID of the connector. Read-only; required for update operations.

url.description: Endpoint URL, that is, URL of the receiver. User macros are supported.

protocol.description: Communication protocol. Possible values: 0 - (default) Zabbix Streaming Protocol v1.0.

data_type.description: Data type. Possible values: 0 - (default) Item values; 1 - Events.

item_value_type.description: A sum of item value types to be sent (bitmask). Possible values: 1 - Numeric (float); 2 - Character; 4 - Log; 8 - Numeric (unsigned); 16 - Text; 32 - Binary (supported since Zabbix 7.0.5). Default: 31 - All item types (except binary). Supported if data_type is set to "Item values" (0).

max_records.description: Maximum number of events or items that can be sent within one message. Possible values: 0-2147483647 (max value of 32-bit signed integer). Default: 0 - Unlimited.

max_senders.description: Number of sender processes to run for this connector. Possible values: 1-100. Default: 1.

max_attempts.description: Number of attempts. Possible values: 1-5. Default: 1.

attempt_interval.description: The interval between retry attempts. Accepts seconds. Possible values: 0s-10s. Default: 5s. Supported if max_attempts is greater than 1.

timeout.description: Timeout. Time suffixes are supported (e.g., 30s, 1m). User macros are supported. Possible values: 1s-60s. Default: 5s.

http_proxy.description: HTTP(S) proxy connection string given as [protocol]://[username[:password]@]proxy.example.com[:port]. User macros are supported.

authtype.description: HTTP authentication method. Possible values: 0 - (default) None; 1 - Basic; 2 - NTLM; 3 - Kerberos; 4 - Digest; 5 - Bearer.

username.description: User name. User macros are supported. Supported if authtype is set to "Basic", "NTLM", "Kerberos", or "Digest".

password.description: Password. User macros are supported. Supported if authtype is set to "Basic", "NTLM", "Kerberos", or "Digest".

token.description: Bearer token. User macros are supported. Required if authtype is set to "Bearer".

verify_peer.description: Whether to validate that the host's certificate is authentic. Possible values: 0 - Do not validate; 1 - (default) Validate.

verify_host.description: Whether to validate that the host name for the connection matches the one in the host's certificate. Possible values: 0 - Do not validate; 1 - (default) Validate.

ssl_cert_file.description: Public SSL Key file path. User macros are supported.

ssl_key_file.description: Private SSL Key file path. User macros are supported.

ssl_key_password.description: Password for SSL Key file. User macros are supported.

status.description: Whether the connector is enabled. Possible values: 0 - Disabled; 1 - (default) Enabled.

tags_evaltype.description: Tag evaluation method. Possible values: 0 - (default) And/Or; 2 - Or.

tags.description: Connector tag filter to replace the current tag filter.

operator.description: Condition operator. Possible values: 0 - (default) Equals; 1 - Does not equal; 2 - Contains; 3 - Does not contain; 12 - Exists; 13 - Does not exist.
